name: Supergreen Matcha Smoothie Bowl
steps: Chuck the banana, mango, pineapple, spinach, matcha, protein powder, almond milk, skyr, honey and chia seeds into a blender. Blitz until completely smooth and creamy – you want it super thick, so use a tamper or stop and stir between blends if needed.
Scoop the smoothie into a bowl. Top with sliced kiwi, strawberries, a sprinkle of desiccated coconut and some granola, if using.
